verdict.rationale: Smithery's official, maintained CLI provides scriptable command-line operations (registry search/add/list/remove and tool list/find/get/call), which makes non-interactive automation plausible. However, nothing documents headless or CI use specifically. The hosted REST API, Connect and service-tied CLI versions were also shut down on 2026-10-31, which narrows what automation can reach. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI documentation, documented non-interactive auth for pipelines, a still-supported programmatic API surface, and hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Smithery CLI connects your agents to thousands of skills and MCP servers directly from the command line.
The CLI itself continues under the acquirer's org (github.com/arcadeai-labs/smithery-cli, npm smithery@latest) against the public registry
